spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Mobile-first. 'p-4' is baseline, 'p-6' for cards.

surface_strategy.bottom_nav: bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-stone-200 shadow-[0_-10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)] pb-safe pt-2

buttons.primary: bg-[#2F7C4C] text-white rounded-xl py-4 px-6 font-semibold active:scale-95 transition-transform
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#1C1917] border border-stone-200 rounded-xl py-4 px-6 font-semibold active:bg-stone-50
buttons.fab: absolute bottom-6 right-6 bg-[#2F7C4C] shadow-lg rounded-full w-14 h-14 flex items-center justify-center active:scale-90

inputs.search: bg-white border-stone-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-base flex-row items-center gap-2
inputs.qty_control: flex-row items-center bg-stone-100 rounded-full px-1 py-1

stock_item_card.layout: flex-row items-center p-4 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-stone-100 shadow-sm mb-3
stock_item_card.emoji_container: w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-stone-50 flex items-center justify-center text-2xl mr-4

shopping_list_item.layout: flex-row items-center py-3 border-b border-stone-100 last:border-b-0
shopping_list_item.checkbox: w-6 h-6 rounded-full border-2 border-stone-300 mr-3 active:bg-brand_primary
shopping_list_item.price_tag: font-mono text-sm text-stone-500 bg-stone-100 px-2 py-1 rounded

onboarding.layout: Hero image taking top 50%, bottom 50% white card pulling up with h1, body, and primary full-width button.

estoque_stock.content: Horizontal scroll chips for categories (Hortifruti, Laticínios, etc). Vertical list of Stock Item Cards.
estoque_stock.action: Floating Action Button to add item manually or scan.

lista_shopping_list.content: Items below min-stock automatically appear. Swipable list items. 'Scan Receipt' big CTA at bottom to mark purchased.

scanner.ui: Camera view taking full screen. Overlay with focus box. Haptic feedback on capture. Monospaced font for data extraction preview overlay.

receitas_recipes.layout: Bento grid of recipe cards. If ingredients missing, red 'Faltam 2' badge. CTA 'Add missing to List'.

comunidade.layout: Feed of price updates. Anonymous avatars. Up/down trend arrows for prices.

interactions.haptics: MANDATORY on all button presses, list swiping, qty increments, and successful receipt scans.
interactions.transitions: Smooth spring animations for expanding cards (recipes/price history).
interactions.test_ids: Use data-testid on ALL interactive elements (e.g., 'btn-add-stock', 'tab-lista', 'input-search').

images.description: Warm aesthetic illustration of Brazilian kitchen counter
Soft organic texture background for headers or cards
3D minimalist art of glowing receipt for scanner empty state

instructions_to_main_agent: Use NativeWind or pure React Native StyleSheet following these token scales.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use Manrope for headings and Figtree for body.
For Price History and Receipt scanning data, use Roboto Mono to align columns perfectly.
Implement soft shadows + 1px borders on cards to match the 'Clay & Crisp' surface strategy.
Add 'data-testid' to every interactive button, tab, and input.
